findings.location: Titus 2:3–5 quotation; repeated in the later Titus 2:4–5 quotations (3 occurrences)
findings.suggested_fix: In each occurrence, render this as “vara hemma och sköta hemmet” to retain the source’s emphasis on being at home, not only on household tasks.
Consider “ett nytt modeord – tillfredsställelse” to convey “fulfillment” without introducing the additional idea of self-realization.
